During the inquest I received evidence that the practice had not carried out any internal investigation in relation to this death and the practice accepted it should have done. I am concerned that the practice does not have adequate systems in place to ensure that patient safety incidents are reviewed in a timely way to allow lessons to be drawn from the findings.
